conversation_starters.title: Flood leaves fish stranded as Cibolo Creek reaches record level
conversation_starters.summary: Historic floodwaters transformed the Cibolo Center for Conservation, a nature preserve in Boerne about 30 miles northwest of San Antonio, leaving hundreds of fish stranded and reshaping the landscape in just a few hours.
questions: Have you ever been out to the Cibolo Center for Conservation?
Did the flooding change anything about the places you usually go?
